constraints: set1 and set2 must both belong to the same table; resultSet is created on that same table.
resultSet replaces any existing set with the same name, including reusing the name of set1 or set2.
The resulting set's current record is the current record of set1.
In Client/Server mode, all three sets must be visible (interprocess, process, or local, created on the appropriate machine) to the calling process.
